name: Chatrix Web Chat
author: OLERAJ

sections.description:
Chatrix Web Chat is a modern, fast, and feature-rich live chat solution for your WordPress website. Engage with your visitors in real-time through a beautiful, customizable widget that seamlessly integrates into your site.

Unlike many live chat solutions, Chatrix Web Chat is completely self-hosted, storing all data securely on your server. Manage conversations directly from your WordPress admin dashboard with a dedicated, intuitive inbox interface.

Features

  • Completely Self-Hosted: All messages and media stay on your server.
  • Modern Interface: Premium chat experience inspired by top messaging apps.
  • Dedicated Dashboard: Manage all conversations in real-time from a beautifully designed WP admin page.
  • Rich Media Support: Users can send text, voice notes, images, and documents.
  • Customization: Tailor the brand color, logo, and header texts to match your website.
  • Smart Notifications: Visual and audio cues for new messages.

External services

This plugin is entirely self-contained. It relies on the WordPress REST API and the local database to handle real-time chat polling.
It does not connect to, communicate with, or load assets from any third-party external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatrix-web-chat directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings->Chatrix Web Chat screen to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use third-party services?

No, Chatrix Web Chat operates entirely on your server using the WordPress REST API.

Can I change the color of the chat widget?

Yes, you can easily change the primary brand color and the logo via the plugin settings page.

Where are the files stored when users upload them?

They are uploaded securely into your WordPress media library and are scheduled for automatic cleanup after 30 days to save server space.
